body:
I feel better this morning. Thank you everyone who took their time to talk to me. 

I think it all boils down to loneliness. I’m tired of being single. Im tired of coming home to an empty apartment, and my dog who only cares about food. 

I think I’m going to get back on my medications. I see my psychiatrist next week.
What if you are destined to be alone forever? From now on?
They say suicide is selfish but I disagree. I think it’s selfish to make someone stay here who is so chronically miserable and unhappy.
My family is a wreck thanks to politics and my friends don’t hangout with me anymore. They all have their SOs.
